_comment: Omnix Link / Relay Link — import into Jexactyl nest, then assign to the Hyderabad egg
name: Omnix Link
author: admin@omnixstudio.xyz
description: Omnix Link (Relay Link) — FastAPI companion for StreamRelay OAuth handoff.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z "{{PY_PACKAGES}}" ]]; then pip install -U --prefix .local {{PY_PACKAGES}}; fi; if [[ -f /home/container/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE} ]]; then pip install -U --prefix .local -r ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}; fi; /usr/local/bin/python /home/container/{{PY_FILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ libtool
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
  echo "user upload — skip clone"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git; fi
if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi
if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
  if [ -d .git ]; then git pull || true; fi
else
  if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
  else git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
  fi
fi
export HOME=/mnt/server
if [[ ! -z ${PY_PACKAGES} ]]; then pip install -U --prefix .local ${PY_PACKAGES}; fi
if [ -f /mnt/server/requirements.txt ]; then pip install -U --prefix .local -r ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}; fi
echo "install complete"
exit 0
